Subject: Revised constitution and functioning of Medical
Boards under Section 37 of the Code on Social Security,

Madam/Sir,

The Medical Boards constituted under Section 37 of the Code
on Social Security, 2020, are required to examine and assess Insured
Persons in cases where such examination is prescribed for determination
of entitlement to beneﬁts under the Code and the regulations made
thereunder.

With a view to ensuring uniformity in the constitution and functioning of
Medical Boards, regular conduct of the Boards and timely disposal of
cases of Insured Persons, the Competent Authority has approved the
following arrangements with immediate effect:

I. FIXED MEDICAL BOARD:

The Fixed Medical Board shall ordinarily be convened at least once
every month. As far as practicable, the meeting shall be scheduled on
the ﬁrst Tuesday of every month from 09:00 AM to 02:00 PM ,
subject to availability of the required members and administrative
convenience. The concerned Medical Superintendent shall ensure
regular conduct of the Board and timely consideration of the cases
placed before it. The Fixed Medical Board shall be constituted as
follows:

a. In ESIC Hospitals: The Fixed Medical Board at ESIC Hospital
shall be constituted as follows:

II. ROTATIONAL PERIPATETIC MEDICAL BOARD:

T h e Rotational Peripatetic Medical Board shall be convened at
diﬀerent ESIC/ESIS Hospitals, as per the requirement, with a view to
extending Medical Board facilities to areas where a Fixed Medical Board
is not available and to facilitate consideration of cases arising from
outlying and geographically distant areas. The frequency and venue of
such Boards shall be determined based on the number of pending
cases, geographical coverage, accessibility for Insured Persons
and other operational requirements, so as to ensure timely and
convenient disposal of cases. Whenever such Board is convened at a
particular location, the Medical Superintendent of the ESIC/ESIS
Hospital at that location shall function as the Chairman of the

III. SPECIAL MEDICAL BOARD FOR OCCUPATIONAL
DISEASE CASES:

T h e Special Medical Board for cases relating to Occupational
Disease shall continue to be convened only at the designated ESIC
Hospitals/Occupational Disease Centres notiﬁed for the purpose. The
constitution and functioning of such Boards shall be governed by the
provisions of the relevant Occupational Disease Manual and the
instructions issued by the Corporation from time to time. Wherever
required, a technical/domain expert may be included in the Special
Medical Board, in addition to the prescribed members, in accordance
with the applicable provisions of the Occupational Disease Manual. The
existing arrangements relating to the designated Occupational Disease
Centres and the constitution of Special Medical Boards shall continue to
remain in force unless speciﬁcally modiﬁed or superseded by separate
orders issued by the competent authority.

Other conditions:

i. Wherever considered necessary, the Chairman of the
Medical Board may co-opt an additional Specialist, depending
upon the nature and requirements of the case. Such Specialist
may be drawn from an ESIC/ESIS Hospital, Government Hospital
or any other suitable medical institution, as per the applicable
rules and instructions. The requirement for such additional
specialist opinion shall be duly recorded in the proceedings of
the Medical Board.

ii. The concerned Regional Oﬃce/Sub-Regional Oﬃce , in

consultation with the Medical Superintendent, shall make
necessary administrative arrangements for the conduct of
Medical Boards, including timely compilation of cases,
availability of complete medical records, intimation to Insured
Persons, logistics, admissible conveyance and honorarium to
external members, wherever applicable. The RO/SRO shall also
ensure proper coordination with the Medical Board and timely
forwarding of its recommendations to the concerned authority
for further necessary action.

iii. The proceedings of each Medical Board shall be properly
recorded and maintained. The concerned RO/SRO shall monitor
the functioning of Medical Boards and maintain requisite
records regarding cases considered, disposed of and pending,
with reasons for pendency wherever applicable, so as to
facilitate timely disposal of cases.

iv. The existing provisions relating to the Code of Social
Security- 2020, applicable rules, manuals, honorarium,
TA/DA, conveyance and other admissible expenditure, as
well as instructions issued by the Corporation from time to time,
shall continue to apply. In case of non-availability of any
prescribed Specialist, suitable alternative arrangements may be
made with the approval of the competent authority in
accordance with the applicable instructions.

These instructions shall come into force with immediate eﬀect and
shall be complied with by all concerned ESIC/ESIS Hospitals and
Regional/Sub-Regional Offices.

This issues with the approval of the Director General.

Yours faithfully,

Digvijay Prasad Sinha
JOINT DIRECTOR
